request.description: Creates a user with the UserModel schema: email and password.
Creates an admin account and matching normal user row so admin JWT auth works.
Gets the logged-in user's profile. Run Auth/Login first so {{accessToken}} is set.
Gets the logged-in admin profile. Run Auth/Admin Login first so {{adminAccessToken}} is set.
Gets one user by id.
Creates documentation owned by the logged-in user. Run Auth/Login first so {{accessToken}} is set.
Updates one documentation record by id. Run Auth/Login first so {{accessToken}} is set.
Deletes one documentation record by id.
Gets every documentation record.
Exports every documentation table row as CSV.

request.description: Gets TD_md values for documentation owned by the logged-in user. Run Auth/Login first so {{accessToken}} is set.
Gets one documentation record by documentation id.

item.name: Get IBD Markdown By Documentation ID

request.description: Gets only the IBD_generated_md field for one documentation id. Response shape: { "post_IBD": "..." }.

item.name: Get TD Markdown By Documentation ID

request.description: Gets only the TD_md field for one documentation id. Response shape: { "post_TD": "..." }.
Gets the stored invariants for one documentation id. Response shape: { "invariants": ... }. Returns 404 if the id has no invariants.
Updates only the invariants column for one documentation row. Must be the owner. Lists/dicts are stored as JSON text; a plain string is also accepted. Run Auth/Login first so {{accessToken}} is set.
Resolves the source code for a fully-qualified object name (server.py-compatible /api/source endpoint).
Generates candidate invariants from pasted or looked-up source code.
Generates invariant-based Markdown documentation and saves it (markdown + approved invariants) to the database under the anonymous owner. Response includes documentation_id.

Streams generated Markdown as text/plain so the frontend can render progressively. Once the stream completes, the full document (markdown + approved invariants) is saved to the database under the anonymous owner.
Calculates validity/soundness and mutation metrics (server.py-compatible /api/metrics endpoint).
Analyzes mutation survivors for one generated Hypothesis test.
Re-runs one generated test and returns the metric object.
Maps generated documentation claims back to source-code evidence.
Returns provider options for the frontend dropdown.
Validates a provider choice. Returns 400 for an unknown provider. Valid ids: openai, claude, cmu_gateway.
Frontend-friendly alias for /model-api/providers that sits beside the other /api routes.
Frontend-friendly alias for /model-api/selection.
Gets a random stored documentation row for comparing TD markdown against generated IBD markdown.
Saves the logged-in user's TD/IBD preference for a documentation comparison. Run Auth/Login first, and optionally run Get Random Comparison to set {{comparisonDocumentationId}}.

request.description: Returns documentation rows with votes, ranked by IBD Elo rating, with Elo, Bradley-Terry, vote counts, and win percentages.
Generates assessment questions for one documentation row using the selected model provider. Valid provider ids: openai, claude, cmu_gateway. Requires the logged-in user to be listed as an admin.
Gets a random assessment for the logged-in user, randomly choosing TD or IBD documentation and creating an assessment attempt. Run Auth/Login first so {{accessToken}} is set.
Submits one answer for the logged-in user's assessment attempt. Run Get Random Assessment first so {{assessmentAttemptId}} and {{assessmentQuestionId}} are set.
Gets answer statistics for the logged-in user. Run Auth/Login first so {{accessToken}} is set.
Exports assessment data as CSV for the logged-in user. Run Auth/Login first so {{accessToken}} is set.
Manually creates one assessment question as an admin. Requires admin auth; run Auth/Admin Login first so {{adminAccessToken}} is set.
Updates one assessment question. Requires admin auth; run Auth/Admin Login first so {{adminAccessToken}} is set.
Deletes one assessment question. Requires admin auth; run Auth/Admin Login first so {{adminAccessToken}} is set.
Logs in with OAuth2PasswordRequestForm fields. The route is declared as POST in app/routers/auth.py.
Logs in an admin user with OAuth2PasswordRequestForm fields. The returned token is saved to {{adminAccessToken}} and {{accessToken}}.
Duplicate this request for routes that require Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}.
